mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_master ( stock_code, stock_name, market_type, sector_name, industry_name, corp_code, is_active, is_watched ) VALUES ( #{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{marketType}, #{sectorName}, #{industryName}, #{corpCode}, #{isActive}, COALESCE(#{isWatched}, 0) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_name = VALUES(stock_name), market_type = CASE WHEN VALUES(market_type) IS NULL OR VALUES(market_type) = 'UNKNOWN' THEN market_type ELSE VALUES(market_type) END, sector_name = COALESCE(VALUES(sector_name), sector_name), industry_name = COALESCE(VALUES(industry_name), industry_name), corp_code = COALESCE(VALUES(corp_code), corp_code), is_active = VALUES(is_active), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT stock_code, stock_name, market_type, sector_name, industry_name, corp_code, is_active, is_watched, listed_date, delisted_date, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_master WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode}

SELECT stock_code, stock_name, market_type, sector_name, industry_name, corp_code, is_active, is_watched, listed_date, delisted_date, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_master WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY stock_code

SELECT stock_code, stock_name, market_type, sector_name, industry_name, corp_code, is_active, is_watched, listed_date, delisted_date, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_master WHERE is_active = 1 AND is_watched = 1 ORDER BY stock_code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_master WHERE is_active = 1 AND is_watched = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_master SET is_watched = #{isWatched}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode}
UPDATE stock_master SET market_type = #{marketType}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode}

UPDATE stock_master sm SET sm.is_watched = 1, sm.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE sm.is_active = 1 AND sm.stock_code IN ( SELECT stock_code FROM portfolio_position WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} AND quantity > 0 UNION SELECT stock_code FROM paper_portfolio_position WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} AND quantity > 0 )

UPDATE stock_master sm JOIN ( SELECT selected.stock_code FROM ( SELECT sm_inner.stock_code FROM stock_master sm_inner WHERE sm_inner.is_active = 1 AND sm_inner.is_watched = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM portfolio_position pp WHERE pp.account_no = #{accountNo} AND pp.stock_code = sm_inner.stock_code AND pp.quantity > 0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM paper_portfolio_position ppp WHERE ppp.account_no = #{accountNo} AND ppp.stock_code = sm_inner.stock_code AND ppp.quantity > 0 ) ORDER BY sm_inner.updated_at ASC, sm_inner.stock_code ASC LIMIT #{limit} ) selected ) old_watched ON old_watched.stock_code = sm.stock_code SET sm.is_watched = 0, sm.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
